proposed_widenings.name: FeatRecord / feat mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'feat' variant. No FeatRecord type exists in types.ts, and no feat mechanics family is defined. Feats are a distinct source-root atom (feat_root) in v4 taxonomy but have no surface encoding path.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense surface type
proposed_widenings.justification: Truesight is a special sense granted permanently by this feat. The v4 atom 'grant_sense' exists in the taxonomy but there is no corresponding surface type in types.ts to carry its parameters (sense kind, range in feet, permanent vs. timed).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Truesight. You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_score_increase surface type
proposed_widenings.justification: The feat grants +1 to a chosen ability score (max 30). The v4 taxonomy explicitly marks 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state' as out-of-scope. A feat record family would need to either include this as a surface type or document it as a deferred mechanic.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

notes: Hard structural block: UnitRecord does not include a 'feat' kind. The tracer's top-level switch handles 'spell' | 'class_feature' | 'mastery' only — any feat JSON would throw at the first exhaustive check. Both of this feat's mechanics (grant_sense for Truesight, modify_ability_score for ASI) also lack surface types, making even a hypothetical partial encoding impossible without lying. The Ability Score Increase rider is common to all Epic Boon feats and would need a shared surface shape once feat support lands.
